Subject: Post-demo questions: data residency & export controls

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. A few follow-ups from our security and procurement teams to help us move forward: 

1) SOC 2 status — do you have a current Type II report or an executive summary we can review?
2) Data residency — can Redwood guarantee processing and storage within the EU (specific to Sweden/Frankfurt region)? Any timelines if not yet available?
3) Cross-border transfers — what standard contractual mechanisms or data transfer bases do you use?
4) Export controls / restricted data — we need to understand OFAC/ITAR screening or limitations for model inferencing (some of our clinical partners operate in constrained geographies).
5) Vendor questionnaire — attaching our security questionnaire (short PDF). Can you indicate who will fill this out and an expected turnaround?

Proposed next steps: if you can send SOC2 docs + a short note on residency + a first-pass on the questionnaire by EOD Friday, that would help our SRE and legal teams decide next steps.

Thanks,
Annette

Hi Annette —

Great to meet you and appreciate the clear list. Quick recap and commitments from our side: 

- SOC 2: We have a current SOC 2 coverage profile and a concise executive summary — attaching the 1-page summary now (RWI-SOC2-summary.pdf). We can share the Type II report under NDA; happy to coordinate with your team.
- EU residency: We currently serve customers from our EU region (Frankfurt) for most models — we can guarantee storage and inference within EU-controlled infrastructure when you choose the EU region option or a Dedicated/Private deployment. If you need an on-prem or VPC option for clinical data, that is available (timeline depends on procurement).
- Cross-border transfers: We rely on SCCs plus a risk-based transfer analysis; standard contractual addenda are available for enterprise contracts.
- Export controls / OFAC/ITAR: We do routine screening and have a policy for restricted content; however, ITAR/defense-specific workflows often require private deployments and contractual carve-outs. I’ve looped in Priyom from security to confirm specifics.

Next steps I propose:
1) Priyom to review your questionnaire and provide answers / redlines (target: 48–72 hours).
2) If you want, we can schedule a short call with your security team and Priyom — 30 minutes to cover SOC2 scope and residency details.
3) Ben will follow up on pricing for a Dedicated EU pool or VPC option and an estimated procurement timeline.

Attaching the SOC2 summary. If you prefer the Type II report, let me know and we’ll coordinate an NDA.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa / team — initial answers below (short-form so we can get back to the customer quickly). I’ll edit the questionnaire PDF with formal answers and return the updated PDF by EOD Monday.

1) SOC 2: We have SOC 2 Type II readiness; summary attached previously. Full report is available under standard NDA — legal can push an NDA template if Nordic Health prefers.

2) EU residency: We support EU-region (Frankfurt) processing and can isolate both compute and storage to the EU for hosted customers using the EU-region flag. For Dedicated pools we guarantee EU-only nodes and storage. For Private/VPC we can deploy into a customer VPC or on-prem package; typical delivery time for a dedicated pool is ~4–8 weeks from contract signature depending on sizing.

3) Cross-border transfers: We use standard contractual clauses (SCCs) + data processing addenda. We can sign EU SCCs and provide the DPA referenced in our contracts.

4) OFAC / ITAR: Our intake pipeline performs sanctions screening; however, ITAR-controlled technical data and defense-specific content requires private deployment and contract-level controls. If Nordic Health expects to process any ITAR-controlled data, we recommend Private deployment and a contract appendix describing screening and access controls.

5) Questionnaire: I will fill out the technical Qs and flag any items that require legal/contract language. Expect a returned PDF and short cover note Monday.

Let me know if you want me on the call with Nordic Health — happy to join.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
